Display: 48–64 px • Section: 28–32 px • Body: 14–18 px • Labels: 10–12 px

This package is designed for direct SVG import into Figma. Text remains vector text and layout elements remain vector shapes.
The supplied logo and reference imagery are embedded/linked assets. For production, replace concept imagery with licensed final photography and convert the final logo to true vector artwork.
